response: The supplied evidence shows a redundant hook, not a broken delivery process. Keep the working pre-commit and CI tests. No urgent repair is evidenced.

findings.claim: The PostToolUse formatter provides no formatting or validation.
findings.evidence: Scenario: its only operation is exit 0.
findings.behavior: It cannot catch formatting or test failures despite its label.
findings.repair: Remove the empty registration or implement an actual needed check at an effective control point; no new hook is required.
findings.verification: Inspect its command and caller; if replaced, demonstrate changed input and a failing check with propagated failure.

findings.claim: Pre-commit and CI tests are working according to supplied evidence.
findings.behavior: Existing delivery control points supply value.
findings.verification: Audit actual entrypoints and intentionally failing test exit propagation before extending this to an independently verified claim.

findings.claim: Absent Stop hook is not itself a defect.
findings.evidence: No Stop hook, with working pre-commit/CI and no observed task failures.
findings.behavior: Completion lifecycle enforcement has not been tested.
findings.repair: Add a hook only if a reproduced gap calls for it and native trust permits it.
findings.verification: Observe relevant lifecycle and failure cases; a Stop hook would not intercept commits.

findings.claim: 85 CLAUDE.md lines do not establish an instruction defect.
findings.repair: Inspect stale/conflicting policy and unconditional work while preserving project invariants and permissions.
findings.verification: Evaluate representative tasks before/after any justified change.

findings.claim: Token, cost and unobserved failure rates are unknown.
findings.evidence: No host cost data; no observed failures.
findings.repair: Use actual host observability if available; no invented estimates or hook-count health score.
findings.verification: Collect measured outcomes with disclosed sample size.

approval_handling: Findings only as requested. No configuration changes, commit, Issue write, push, deployment or account changes authorized or performed.
